snippet.title: Duel Timers Gameplay Footage!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Duel Timers on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2380830/Duel_Timers/

Duel Timers is a local multiplayer split screen game where players duel each other on a vertical map. Soar through the sky with Double Jumping, Quick Falling, and Charge Jumping! Collect ammo and health kits to keep the fight going! Pick your Weapons and Power-Ups wisely!
